title: DeFi Franc (DCHF) — Liquity-style CDP, Ethereum: E-U $0, ~$680k live all H-O/P/S
closed_reasons: No liquidatable troves: ICRs 174.35% (ETH, 1 trove), 856.3% and 919.0% (WBTC, 2 troves) vs MCR 110%; liquidate()/batchLiquidateTroves() revert (0L) — fork-verified
Redemption is fair-value-minus-fee: 1000 DCHF -> 0.4597 ETH vs 0.4694 ETH fair; fee = floor 0.5% + baseRate (fork BETA=2, 7-min decay); redeeming is always a loss — fork-verified
Mint+redeem round trip is circular: 2100 DCHF borrowed (0.5% fee) redeemed back for 0.9507 ETH on 2 ETH collateral — fork-verified
Stability pools have zero DCHF deposits; withdrawFromSP(0) pays only the recorded depositor's snapshot gain; stranger reverts 'User must have a non-zero deposit' — fork-verified
CollSurplusPool claims are gated to the recorded trove owner (BO.claimCollateral(msg.sender)); stranger reverts 'No collateral available to claim'; 21 EOAs hold all $254k — fork-verified

Last trove of a collateral can never be closed (_requireMoreThanOneTroveInSystem in _closeTrove): the ETH trove is permanently unclosable even with full DCHF — fork-verified; WBTC owners can close (owner recovered 0.80396 WBTC)
MONStaking: fresh stakers' snapshots are set at stake time -> zero historical rewards — fork-verified; rewards H-O for incumbent stakers

AirdropMON: ~$53.2k of harvested rewards is unattributed to its 28 users (per-user F-scaled claims total only ~$187); sweep() explicitly protects DCHF/MON/ETH/WBTC; owner sweep reverts — fork-verified

Only DCHF market is a near-dead UniV3 DCHF/USDC pool: sells max 4.744 DCHF ever ($100 USDC -> 4.744 DCHF); buy+redeem gross +$0.126 per $3 cycle, gas 643k = $1.64 at 1 gwei -> net negative — fork-executed
GasPool's 600 DCHF is only reachable via liquidation/close of troves; none liquidatable — frozen
Privileged only: Gnosis Safe (2-of-3) is owner of BO/TM/DCHF/params; can add a malicious BorrowerOps to the DCHF token and mint/drain (P); LockedMON and CommunityIssuance are team-scoped
key_facts: Full live balance sheet ~$679.8k vs triage $286,773: triage missed CollSurplusPool ($254,040) and both stability pools ($61,493)

DCHF supply 51,876.7523; largest holders AirdropMON 21,339, MONStaking 6,441, EOA 0xdcb11e81 3,808, EOA 0x1815cddd 2,351; V3 pool 981; GasPool 600

The only DCHF market (UniV3 DCHF/USDC 0x0b1debf6) spot ~1.094 USDC/DCHF vs redemption ~1.199; usable liquidity 4.744 DCHF + $5.94; 976.5 DCHF of direct donations are uncollectable in the pool contract

E-U headline $0 high confidence; max theoretical gross arb $0.126/cycle, net -$1.51 at 1 gwei gas
caveats: USD values at ETH $2,541.98 / WBTC $83,505.5 / CHF/USD 1.20480842 (2026-10-12); they move with prices
MON is illiquid (~$0.000217 from the MON/WETH V3 pool); MON-denominated amounts (MONStaking/LockedMON/CommunityIssuance) are indicative
A ~1,322 DCHF sliver (2.5% of supply) sits in addresses not fully enumerated (transfer-scan gaps in the 2022 deployment window); it is spread across EOAs and cannot alter the E-U verdict
H-O extraction for trove collateral requires repayment/redemption or staying above the 150% system TCR / 110% trove limits; the ETH trove is unclosable (last-trove lock)
The $0.126 arb is not reproducible at scale — capped by the pool's single active position; it disappears entirely at normal gas
Fork tests fork at latest (fork block varies per run); exact numbers cited are from CI run 38230188670 at block 26,175,501
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from DeFi Franc (high confidence): no liquidatable troves (ICRs 174-919%), redemptions are fair-value-minus-fee, SP/CollSurplus/MONStaking claims are strictly owner-gated, ~$53k inside AirdropMON is provably unclaimable, and the only DCHF market sells 4.74 DCHF for a $0.126 gross arb that is gas-negative (net -$1.51 at 1 gwei); ~$586k remains holder-recoverable (H-O) and ~$92k is stuck (S).
